label: Inspect maintenance estimates and separate heap, index and total sizes
sql:
SELECT relname, n_live_tup, n_dead_tup,
       last_vacuum, last_autovacuum,
       last_analyze, last_autoanalyze
FROM pg_stat_user_tables
WHERE relid = 'public.products'::regclass;

SELECT pg_relation_size('public.products') AS heap_bytes,
       pg_indexes_size('public.products') AS index_bytes,
       pg_total_relation_size('public.products') AS total_bytes;

label: Find sessions with transaction or snapshot age
sql:
SELECT pid, datname, application_name, state,
       xact_start, query_start,
       age(backend_xid) AS xid_age,
       age(backend_xmin) AS xmin_age,
       wait_event_type, wait_event
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE backend_xid IS NOT NULL OR backend_xmin IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY GREATEST(age(backend_xid), age(backend_xmin))
         DESC NULLS LAST;

label: Inspect other retention horizons
sql:
SELECT gid, database, owner, prepared,
       age(transaction) AS xid_age
FROM pg_prepared_xacts
ORDER BY age(transaction) DESC;

SELECT slot_name, slot_type, active,
       age(xmin) AS xmin_age,
       age(catalog_xmin) AS catalog_xmin_age,
       restart_lsn
FROM pg_replication_slots;

SELECT pid, application_name, state,
       age(backend_xmin) AS feedback_xmin_age
FROM pg_stat_replication;

label: Inspect table and database transaction and MultiXact ages
sql:
SELECT c.oid::regclass AS relation,
       age(c.relfrozenxid) AS xid_age,
       mxid_age(c.relminmxid) AS multixact_age
FROM pg_class AS c
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'm', 't')
ORDER BY age(c.relfrozenxid) DESC;

SELECT datname, age(datfrozenxid) AS xid_age,
       mxid_age(datminmxid) AS multixact_age
FROM pg_database
ORDER BY age(datfrozenxid) DESC;

label: Inspect vacuum configuration without changing it
sql:
SELECT oid::regclass AS relation, reloptions
FROM pg_class
WHERE oid = 'public.products'::regclass;

SELECT name, setting, unit, source
FROM pg_settings
WHERE name LIKE 'autovacuum%'
   OR name LIKE 'vacuum%'
ORDER BY name;

label: Read vacuum phases and waits in the current database
sql:
SELECT p.pid, p.relid::regclass AS relation, p.phase,
       p.heap_blks_total, p.heap_blks_scanned,
       p.heap_blks_vacuumed, p.index_vacuum_count,
       a.wait_event_type, a.wait_event
FROM pg_stat_progress_vacuum AS p
LEFT JOIN pg_stat_activity AS a USING (pid)
WHERE p.datid = (SELECT oid FROM pg_database
                 WHERE datname = current_database());
